You are standing in mud to your knees. This is not the kind of place
for a picnic. The muddy sewer stretches further into the south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the muddy sewer continuing into the darkness to the south.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7001 to 7002

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The muddy sewer

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The muddy sewer stretches into the dark to the south. It looks as if
no person has ever sat his foot here before. It's too muddy for that
anyway. The sewer leads north, south and east from here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The muddy sewer stretches into the dark to the north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7002 to 7001

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: East. The muddy sewer leads into a bend that goes south.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7002 to 7007

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: South. The muddy sewer ends in a mudhole that way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7002 to 7003

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The muddy sewer junction

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand in mud all the way up to your thighs and it's not too
comfortable since you are used to a somewhat different environment.
The sewer leads to the north of here. In the middle you can just make
out an enormous drainpipe leading down.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: North. The muddy junction lies in that direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7003 to 7002

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The muddy drainpipe leads down through the mud, otherwise it is utterly dark.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7003 to 7101

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The mudhole

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are standing by the edge of a dark pit that leads down into even
deeper darkness. >BWWAAADDRR< - The smell from down there is unbearable.
The sewer stretches into the darkness to the east.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: East. The sewer leads into the sewer junction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7004 to 7009

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
The Dark Pit leads down and down and down ... well you can't see the
bottom anyway. There are bars that function as a ladder on the side.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7004 to 7102

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Dark Pit

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are standing in the middle of a bend of the sewer pipe. It is very
dark around here and the mud is sticking to your legs, not very pleasant.
The pipe leads east and south from here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: East. The mud stretches on into the darkness.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7005 to 7011

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
South. There is even more mud in that direction than where you are now.
Incredible.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7005 to 7006

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The muddy sewer

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are standing in something that reminds you very much of porridge, this
has the advantage that it's not hot, it's rather cold actually. The pipe
bends to the north and east.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The muddy sewer pipe leads into a bend that goes east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7006 to 7005

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
The pipe leads into a bend that goes south. Interesting, there's mud on the
floor there.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7006 to 7012

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The muddy sewer

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This isn't your idea of a place to stay too long. You're in up to your
knees in something that resembles mud, but you're not quite sure. The
bend in which you stand leads west and south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
The pipe leads into a intersection that goes south and east. The floor here
is still covered in mud.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7007 to 7008

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
The pipe (still filled with mud) leads into a intersection that goes north
and south. Interesting.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7007 to 7002

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The muddy sewer bend

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You have both your feet safely stuck in mud. It isn't the mud that's wrong
it's the smell, the sounds, the total darkness that surrounds you. Everything
here is so depressing. The pipe leads on with a trail of thick mud to the
north, east and south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
North. The pipe goes into a bend with a load of mud all the way up the walls.
The bend leads west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7008 to 7007

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
East. This way like a place for the annual mud festival, although the stench
wouldn't allow any happiness at all. The pipe leads into a bend that leads
north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7008 to 7014

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
South. There's less mud in that direction. *smile*. Your light doesn't
cover enough space for you to see much more than that it leads into some
sort of junction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7008 to 7009

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A muddy intersection

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand in the middle of a huge junction of sewer pipes right under
what you'd think was an air shaft. The sewer pipes lead to the north,
south, east and west. It look quite impossible to force your way up.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: North. Mud is the floor basis in that direction. Yummy.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7009 to 7008

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: YYEEUUCH! BOOH! THAT looks like a nice place for creepy crawlies.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7009 to 7017

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
North. This direction looks quite nice actually. The pipe leads into
a bend that goes east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7009 to 7010

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
A few yards ahead - away from this junction - there is a pit leading down,
but the smell from there...>PHEWW<.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7009 to 7004

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Sewer Junction

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in a bend in the sewer pipe. A strong smell seeps in from the north.
The sewer goes north and east.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: North. You are staring into a huge junction with exits in all directions.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7010 to 7009

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: East. The Pipe leads into utter darkness that way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7010 to 7018

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A bend in sewer pipe

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You have entered a kind of tube intersection that leads south, west and east.
Your legs are covered in mud up to the knees. REAL yucky!

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: East. There's less mud in that direction, or that's your impression.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7011 to 7024

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
That way is lost in darkness, though you sense less mud in that direction,
perhaps even a complete end to this sludge that surrounds you.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7011 to 7021

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: West. The mud reaches that way too, all the way up the walls.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7011 to 7005

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The muddy sewer pipe

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This is not your idea of a holiday. You stand in mud up to your knees.
It's absolutely inconceivable how all this mud could have been placed
here. The pipe leads to the west and south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
South. There's even more mud that way, incredible! Although it looks
like an intersection in the sewer system that leads east and south.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7012 to 7013

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
West. All you can see, is that the pipe leads into a bend that goes
north. But there's less mud in that direction, however odd that sounds.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7012 to 7006

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The bend in the Muddy sewer

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You wouldn't want to know the true feeling of standing in this mud up to
your hips. >BWAADR<. All that fills your mind right now is the dream of
a hot bath. This is NOT very clean mud you know, remember you're in the
sewer! The pipes leads north, south and east.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
North. Sludge and sediment fills this corridor of the sewer that leads
into a bend going west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7013 to 7012

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
East. You can see absolutely nothing of interest in that direction (Maybe
that's why it's so damn interesting.??) There's no mud in that direction
either, GREAT!
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7013 to 7026

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
South. All you can see is more mud! Although the pipe goes into a bend
leading west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7013 to 7014

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
It's NOT the kind of matter that would concern you too much, normally, but
as you are in the middle of it, it just might become your main concern.
REAL YUCKY!

It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A MUDDY intersection

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand in a bend of the pipe system of the sewer with mud up to your
thighs. Contemplating a higher level of existence here would be utterly
inappropriate, as the smell would keep any intelligent creature from even
thinking of anything but getting away from this foul end of the WORLD.
The bend goes from north to west.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
North. Filled with mud, that place looks like an impassable intersection
with pipes leading north and east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7014 to 7013

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
West. There's less mud that way, maybe you're on your way out of this foul
place.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7014 to 7008

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Muddy sewer

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are standing by an old and worn well from before this century. The sewer
leads to the east from here and the well leads down into darkness. Metal
bars implanted in the side of the well lead down as a ladder.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
East. You see, because of the utter darkness that surround you, absolutely
nothing. Your light isn't of much use for that kind of distance.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7015 to 7028

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
Down the well there's even less light than up here, so ... sorry, you can't
see a thing. There are metal bars in the side leading down into the darkness.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7015 to 7105

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
These look like they're pretty slippery, and not very safe, but perhaps safe
enough for you to climb down, WITH both hands on them.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The old well

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in the middle of a bend in the pipe system of the sewer system,
WHAT a place!!! The pipe leads to the south and the east.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
East. What a quiet place you've found there. It's an intersection that have
pipeways going north and east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7016 to 7021

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: South. You see nothing at all in that direction it's too dark anyway.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7016 to 7017

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The ordinary bend

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description: You are in a junction that leads north, west and south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: North. You see a bend.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7017 to 7016

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
South. It looks like a pipe junction just like this one. Only that one
leads east and west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7017 to 7018

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: West. There's a junction with four pipelines in that direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7017 to 7009

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The sewer junction

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This looks like an ordinary junction, actually it seems very quiet
here. The pipelines lead west, east and north.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the north you can see a junction like this one, leading north and west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7018 to 7017

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
To the east there's nothing of particular interest, though there's a
junction with pipelines leading north and east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7018 to 7031

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: There's a bend to the west leading north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7018 to 7010

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The ordinary junction

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This is the kind of place to rest, though the smell could be a LOT better
than this. The sewer goes east, north and west from here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: In that direction, you can't see anything. It's just too dark.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7021 to 7011

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: There's an ordinary junction in the pipe system to the east
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7021 to 7029

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
West. There's an ordinary bend leading south into the sewer system in
that direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7021 to 7016

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A quiet pipe junction

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
As you enter you hear a loud click from one of the walls ... and you fall
and fall and fall ...
.
.
.
.
 ... And come to an abrupt end. THIS is strange indeed. There's an arched
entryway leading down.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
Down. It's utterly dark that way, though you can make out an intersection
of sewer pipes leading west, north and east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit entryway 7022 to 7112

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The odd room with smooth walls

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are standing in mud up to your ankles. This is an intersection with
sewer pipes leading east, south and west.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the east there's a peculiar looking round room.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7024 to 7037

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the south there's another intersection with pipes going south and east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7024 to 7025

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
To the west there's another intersection like this one, with sewer pipes
leading south and west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7024 to 7011

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The sewer

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You have never seen anything so BORING...This is an intersection with pipes
leading north, south and east.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
To the north there's an intersection, where the pipes are leading west and
east. You notice that the floor to the west is covered in mud.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7025 to 7024

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
East. You see nothing of interest in that direction, just another
intersection. This one leads east and south.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7025 to 7038

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Another intersection lies to the south. It leads west and south.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7025 to 7026

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Another intersection

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This one seems interesting, a big difference from all the other junctions.
It seems cleaner than the rest of them. Weird. Something that looks like
an air shaft leads upwards, but it looks far too slippery to climb.
The pipes lead to the south, west and north.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: North. You see an intersection there, leading north and east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7026 to 7025

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the south there's ANOTHER junction leading west and east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7026 to 7028

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
To the west you see a load of mud and sediment in the sewer. That should
be an intersection there but you're not quite sure.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7026 to 7013

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
It's dark as tar and looks like something out of a toilet, on top of THAT
the smell is absolutely OVERWHELMING.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A junction

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description: You stand in a junction of sewer pipes leading north, east and west.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the east you can see a bend in the pipe going south.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7028 to 7034

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the west you can just make out an old well.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7028 to 7015

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The sewer junction

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand in the middle of a huge junction of concrete sewer pipes. The
pipes lead into three different directions : east, south and west.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: East. You can see a bend in the sewer pipe leading north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7029 to 7035

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
To the south there's a ENORMOUS quadruple sewer junction, all lit up by
an odd light.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7029 to 7030

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
To the west you can just make out another junction similar to the one
you are standing in.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7029 to 7021

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Triple Junction

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are standing in something that reminds you of an entry to an ant hive.
There are enormous concrete pipes leading north, south, east and west.
There's also a metal ladder built into the concrete wall leading up through
a layer of garbage.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
To the north you can see a huge triple junction with sewer pipes leading
west and east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7030 to 7029

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: East. You can see a pit in the floor.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7030 to 7036

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the south there's a huge junction with pipes leading east and west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7030 to 7031

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the west there's an odd looking room with totally smooth walls.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7030 to 7022

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
Up through the garbage you can just make out what looks like the Dump in
Midgaard.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7030 to 3030

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
It looks as if it's made of stainless steel, and it would very well function
as a club of considerable power, but alas ... You can't take at all since
it's firmly set into the concrete wall.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Quadruple Junction Under the Dump

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description: You stand in a junction with pipes leading west, north and east.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
To the north there's a ENORMOUS quadruple sewer junction, all lit up by
an odd light.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7031 to 7030

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: East. You can just make out a triple junction leading north and east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7031 to 7044

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: West. You can just make out a triple junction leading north and west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7031 to 7018

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A triple junction

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description: You can look in two directions where the pipe leads : south and west.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the south you can see another bend leading west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7034 to 7035

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: West. You can just make out a triple junction leading north and west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7034 to 7028

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A bend in the sewer pipe

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You can look in two different directions where the pipe goes : west and
north.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: North. You see another bend leading west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7035 to 7034

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
You can see another junction although this one is a triple one with pipes
going south and west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7035 to 7029

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The sewer pipe bend

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand in a section of a pipe that leads to a dead end. In the floor
there's a pit leading down. There are bars set in the side of the pit wall
functioning as a ladder.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: West. You can see a dimly lit quadruple junction with an exit up.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7036 to 7030

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Down the pit it's utterly dark you can't see a thing.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7036 to 7122

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The pit

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
As you enter the room it starts rotating - at first slowly, later faster
and faster - You get totally confused as to where up and down are, but you are
certain that the doorway is in the opposite direction of what it was when
you entered. It now leads east. There was only this one exit.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You can just make out a smaller room with a chair.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7037 to 7050

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The round room

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description: You are standing in a junction of pipes that lead west, east and south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: East. You can make out a dimly lit Guard Room.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7038 to 7045

down. You can just make out a huge dark pool out there in the darkness,
mostly because of the trickling of water. The water from the sewer actually
washes over this ledge and makes it quite slippery. From here it drops,

The water trickles quietly down from the ledge above you. The water smells
like the water in a sewer.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The fissure under the ledge

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand in a small room with a great big opening in the ceiling. From this
opening there's mud dripping down in large lumps. >YUCK<. You can smell the
foul stench of the slimy sediment as you try not to get covered by the
falling sludge. To the east there is an entryway leading out from here and
it seems absolutely impossible to force the muddy descent.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: East. You see nothing of interest.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7101 to 7103

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: You never saw such disgusting matter before, it nearly makes you puke.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Under the mudhole

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Nice place you found yourself. You stand in the middle of a room with only
two exits, Up and East. A tall ladder is left here so that you can climb
up through the Pit without the use of a rope.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Up. You can't see a thing up there, it's way too dark.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7102 to 7004

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
This is funny enough a wooden ladder and, after closer inspection, you
discover it is magically held towards the wall! You can't, even with your
greatest effort, rock it at ALL!

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Under the Dark Pit

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are standing in what looks like a bend in the pipe system of the
sewer. The 'floor' is covered completely by mud! This includes covering
your legs up to your knees as well. The pipe leads west and south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
To the south there's less mud than here! It actually seems to end there!
You have a feeling it would be nice to have your feet free from mud again.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7103 to 7104

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
You can see a room in which mud drips from the roof onto the floor in
great cakes of sludge. There doesn't seem to be any exits from that room
apart from in you direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7103 to 7101

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: You never saw such disgusting matter before, it nearly makes you puke.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A junction in the sewer pipes

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are dangling on the slippery sides of the old well leading down and up.
The only secure point here is the metal bars that are cemented into the
sides, the ones that you cling frantically to so that you don't fall. Who
knows how deep this well is?

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
There's a slight, dim light from above, or maybe it's your imagination.
Anyway it SEEMS darker down here than up there, if that is possible.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7105 to 7015

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
Down there nothing at all can be spotted. The darkness that engulfs this
descent seems utterly impossible in a mortal world. It's so thick that a
torch down there would be utterly useless.  You'd better not go down any
further.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7105 to -1

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
These look like they're pretty slippery, and not very safe.  You'd better
not go down any further.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Down the old well

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand, swaying out from the ledge, with only a couple of inches of safe,
solid ledge under your feet. The ledge continues to the east but not back
south. It seems that the ledge is too narrow to turn on so you'll have to
continue forward.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The ledge continues east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  7106 to 7113

no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another exit
from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards.

darkness. You shiver by the thought of falling an utterly unknown distance.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:

hasn't been a living thing in a long time. The dust lies here in a thick
layer on the floor and on the furniture. On the wall hangs a bleak and
worn tapestry. A winding stone staircase leads up into darkness. On the
wall to the west you can see a huge torch stuck into the solid rock.
A large portcullis blocks your way to the north.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Through the portcullis, you can see a faintly lighted hallway leading east.

Very worn and cracks in the surface mingle with the cores of mineral that

This VERY old torch looks as if it has burned for ages, yet no traces of
the searing flame can be seen on it!
This seems like an exceptionally heavy gate, made of thick iron.
